title: Voxel size dx = dy = 20 and 30 um (dz 15 um)
question: Does the tumour depend on the voxel size above the cell size?
observables: alive and dead cells and dead fraction at 24 / 48 / 72 h; distance from the vessel (x) of the furthest living cell and of the proliferative edge (growth rate above half of the maximum); median growth rate in 15 um bins; net exchange fluxes of the 23 metabolites by distance; cap fraction and cap ratio (recorded bound / Michaelis-Menten bound) per substrate; ledger residual
criterion: Fixed before the runs (2026-11-04): living edge and proliferative edge within one 15 um voxel of the reference, dead fraction at 72 h within 10% relative, cell number at 72 h within 10%; the cap fraction reported next to every comparison
rationale: Finer voxels than 15 um are smaller than a cell (2494 um3) and are not run. 360 and 120 are multiples of 20 and 30.

title: dt_diffusion = intracellular_dt 0.005 and 0.02 min with the necrosis increase scaled with dt
question: Does the tumour depend on the time step when the necrosis ramp is held constant?
observables: alive and dead cells and dead fraction at 24 / 48 / 72 h; distance from the vessel (x) of the furthest living cell and of the proliferative edge (growth rate above half of the maximum); median growth rate in 15 um bins; net exchange fluxes of the 23 metabolites by distance; cap fraction and cap ratio (recorded bound / Michaelis-Menten bound) per substrate; ledger residual
criterion: Fixed before the runs (2026-11-04): living edge and proliferative edge within one 15 um voxel of the reference, dead fraction at 72 h within 10% relative, cell number at 72 h within 10%; the cap fraction reported next to every comparison
rationale: death_rate_increase = 1.67e-7 x dt / 0.01 and diffusion_steps = 300 x 0.01 / dt so that the necrosis ramp (1.67e-5 /min2) and the pre-diffusion time (3 min) are the same in every run (as COL-NECS for the colony).
